Program Name: Rustic Pathways - Great Wall to Li River (China)
Price Display: $5,280 at checkout ($5,180 tuition + $100 enrollment fee) + airfare
Description: A four-city, no-service-hours cultural/historical program: walking the Mutianyu Great Wall, the Forbidden City and Temple of Heaven in Beijing, sculpting a miniature terracotta warrior with a Xi'an craftsman near the actual Terracotta Army, a four-hour Li River cruise through karst peaks to Yangshuo with village fieldwork, and the Bund and Yuyuan Garden in Shanghai.
